description.value: Fusion Express is an Indian cuisine restaurant operated by the Students' Union Okanagan on the first floor of the University Centre Building at UBC Okanagan. It is one of several campus eateries run by the SUO, making it a convenient food stop for cyclists passing through or arriving at the university campus. The restaurant sits within the UNC building, a central hub of the UBCO campus in Kelowna.

address.value: 1st floor, University Centre Building (UNC), 3272 University Way, Kelowna, BC V1V 1V7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at suo.ca/fusion-express confirms Fusion Express is a real, operating Indian cuisine restaurant on the 1st floor of the University Centre Building (UNC) at UBC Okanagan, operated by the Students' Union Okanagan. The website provides a full civic address not present in OSM, and the OSM cuisine and restaurant tags are corroborated. No cyclist-specific amenities such as bike parking, water refill, or washroom details are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Website indicates this restaurant operates only during the academic term (September–April), suggesting it may be closed or have reduced service outside of that period — cyclists visiting in summer should verify availability.
No phone number is listed for Fusion Express specifically; the only phone on the website (250-807-8842) is for the SUO office.
OSM had no address; address sourced entirely from the website.
